About the awards

Where the culture gets its flowers.

The Playaz Ball Awards are Canada’s premier celebration of music and creative excellence.

The night honours artists in Hip-Hop, R&B, Dancehall, Afrobeats and Latin music, along with the producers and directors behind the sound and the visuals. It celebrates Toronto’s underground creatives and Black excellence.

Created in honour of Regis Korchinski-Paquet.

Founded by

  • Reece “Twy” Beals
  • Terence “Bugatti” Bonsu
